text: I'm going to ask the user a question with options about what they'd like to work on here, since they just asked for one and it seems like a good way to find out what's useful in this repo.

title: What would you like to work on in this OpenAgent checkout?

options.label: Fix a bug
options.detail: You describe a bug, and I find the cause and fix it, with a test.

options.label: Build a feature
options.detail: Add new behavior to a package or to the dashboard.

options.label: Review recent changes
options.detail: Run a code review on the latest commits or on a PR.

options.label: Explore the codebase
options.detail: I explain how part of the project works, without changing any code.
